description: Correlated transition-metal-oxide G0W0 (MnO2 spin-polarised, NiO type-II AFM). Heavy 3d elements need explicit EXX cutoffs.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: The upstream MnO2 nspin2 case validates nfreq=6.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Keep the screening mesh regular and identical to the SCF mesh.
screening_kgrid.rationale: The transition-metal-oxide cases require a full regular mesh to keep the Coulomb definition consistent.

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use ONCV PBE PPs with a matched 10au/100Ry orbital set for the 3d shell.
basis_family.rationale: Heavy 3d elements need a larger cutoff radius and a matching orbital set.

nao_family.per_system_override_rule: Keep a triple-zeta-plus-polarisation NAO set so the 3d manifold is described.
nao_family.rationale: Underdescribing the 3d manifold is a known garbage-EXX cause for TM oxides.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: Set an explicit small threshold (1e-5, allowed 1e-6..1e-4) instead of the automatic default; heavy elements make the Cs inverse ill-conditioned.
exx_cs_inv_thr.rationale: The automatic Cs inverse cutoff is too aggressive for heavy elements and produces completely wrong EXX bands; this is the recurring heavy-element tuning fix.

shrink_threshold.per_system_override_rule: The upstream MnO2 case uses shrink_abfs_pca_thr 1e-1 because the ABFS set is large for the 3d shell.
